gate-draft.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production RGBA restaurant backdrop sprite, Sushi Loop.
Input images: Image 1 is the current exported 3D entrance sprite, reference only for blue roof/honey timber identity and square-grid camera. Image 2 is the user's original restaurant concept screenshot, the PRIMARY design reference.
Create ONE complete new image-generated restaurant entrance facade, exactly FOUR tiles outer width by THREE tiles projected screen height (4:3 aspect ratio), with a centered TWO tile clear inner opening. Render at 1536x1152 pixels, content touches all four bounds. The left and right one-tile-wide structural bays contain the posts and a warm glowing yellow lantern each. Center opening is exactly half the total width, its jambs at 25% and 75% of the canvas width. The entire gate silhouette fits a flat 4x3 rectangle, no roof wings beyond it.
Recreate the concept's chunky honey-brown timber entrance, blue ceramic roof cap, broad wooden lintel, red three-panel noren curtain with a simple white fish pictogram, dark charcoal interior visible below the curtain, small horizontal stone/wood threshold. Lanterns rest on the side bays within the four tile width; no plants, rocks, crates, floor, props or people.
Camera: straight-on player-facing backdrop in the game's parallel square top/front oblique projection. All front edges exactly screen-horizontal/vertical, no yaw, no perspective convergence, no diamond geometry. Show only a restrained top face along the roof/eave. THREE tiles is the COMPLETE projected screen-space height, including roof depth, NOT a physical height needing further projection. Bottom of posts and threshold align at canvas bottom.
Style: polished chunky faceted low-poly game art like the original concept. Broad matte polygonal surfaces, warm rich amber timber, cobalt/indigo roof, vermilion red noren, buttery gold lanterns. Darker lower surfaces, clear readable contrast, soft internal ambient occlusion and gentle even form shading. Sparse restrained grain, no photorealism, no heavy cartoon outlines. No directional cast shadow outside the art.
Full gate finished edge-to-edge. Genuinely transparent background outside any silhouette notches. The dark doorway is intentionally opaque. No surrounding environment, no text, no measurements, grid, captions, border, watermark or UI. This is a reusable rectangular wall-plane sprite, not a scene screenshot or 3D model preview.
